byScope.label: Scope 1 · Direct
byScope.description: Emissions from sources Terova owns or controls — combustion, fleet and refrigerants.

byScope.label: Scope 2 · Energy
byScope.description: Indirect emissions from purchased electricity, steam and heat.

byScope.label: Scope 3 · Value chain
byScope.description: All 15 upstream & downstream categories — the vast majority of the footprint.

categories.name: Stationary combustion
categories.note: Processing boilers, spice dryers and mills at owned facilities.

categories.name: Mobile combustion
categories.note: Owned collection fleet and yard vehicles.

categories.name: Fugitive emissions
categories.note: Refrigerant leakage from cold storage and chillers.

categories.name: Process emissions
categories.note: Minor process losses in grinding/sterilisation.

categories.name: Purchased electricity
categories.note: Grid electricity for processing lines and cold storage.

categories.name: Purchased steam & heat
categories.note: District steam for sterilisation.

categories.name: Purchased goods & services
categories.note: Farmed raw chilli & spices, packaging, ingredients — the dominant source.

categories.name: Capital goods
categories.note: Processing equipment and facility capex.

categories.name: Fuel- & energy-related activities
categories.note: Upstream of Scope 1 & 2 fuels not already counted.

categories.name: Upstream transportation & distribution
categories.note: Inbound haulage from farms and vendors to plants.

categories.name: Waste generated in operations
categories.note: Processing residues and packaging waste.

categories.name: Business travel
categories.note: Air and hotel from travel management data.

categories.name: Employee commuting
categories.note: Commuting and remote-work energy.

categories.name: Upstream leased assets
categories.note: Leased warehousing not in Scope 1/2.

categories.name: Downstream transportation & distribution
categories.note: Outbound to customers — measured in the Transportation module.

categories.name: Processing of sold products
categories.note: Blending/packing of spices by downstream manufacturers.

categories.name: Use of sold products
categories.note: Negligible — spices require no energy in use.

categories.name: End-of-life treatment of sold products
categories.note: Disposal of packaging after consumer use.

categories.name: Downstream leased assets
categories.note: Leased retail/coldchain space.

categories.name: Franchises
categories.note: Not applicable to Terova’s model.

categories.name: Investments
categories.note: Minority stakes in sourcing co-operatives.

target.name: SBTi 1.5°C-aligned near-term target
target.status: Behind the path — 301 t CO₂e above the 2025 milestone, driven by Scope 3.
